description: Contact as it ships, and the shipping page that demonstrates the one-section prose shape: its body says one thing, so the prose centres to a readable measure with a harmonograph standing in a lane to its left and a Voronoi field in a lane to its right, a mailto button addressed from site settings, and a band with no quote column. It also pins the seam guarantee at app level — the only shipping page that puts something between the prose and the band, and now the case where TWO figures can each break that guarantee independently: both must sit on the join with the band rather than floating above it, which is what the foot slot exists to preserve.
